notes: This book by Julia Cook addresses anxiety and worry in children. Key vocabulary centres on emotions (worry, scared, calm), body sensations (stomach, breathe), and the central metaphor of a 'worry machine' (machine, brain). The existing activity_images already include machine, school, stomach, and backpack which can be reused. 'Better' and 'try' are important as the book ends with coping strategies and reassurance. 'Breathe' is a core coping skill modelled in the book and highly useful for AAC users to communicate during anxious moments.
